Sound familiar?

You know what you want to say. It’s the moment itself that’s hard.

  • The feedback conversation you’ve been putting off for three weeks.
  • The meeting where someone talks over you and you only find the words afterwards.
  • The pushback from a peer or your boss that knocks you off your plan.
  • The work you bring home in your head, long after the laptop is closed.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Lead the conversation, not the reaction

What happens in the brain in a high-stakes moment

The neuroscience of pressure at work, explained in plain English, so the reaction stops feeling personal.

The reset before you respond

A short, practical routine to get back to clear thinking before you answer, in the room or on Zoom.

Difficult conversations, step by step

How to give hard feedback, hold a boundary and handle pushback without over-explaining.

Communicating strategy with authority

What Teresa learned as a COO about framing decisions so senior leaders listen.

Live Q&A with Teresa

Bring the conversation you’re dreading and work through it live.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Is this for new or senior leaders?

Both. If you’ve just stepped into management you’ll leave with a plan for your first hard conversations. If you’re senior you’ll leave with tools for the rooms where the stakes are highest.

What if I can’t make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch it on your own time.

Is this therapy?

No. This is leadership education and coaching, grounded in neuroscience research. It isn’t therapy or medical advice.

Why is it only $17?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, learn the approach, and decide afterwards if you want to go further.

Script 1 · “After the meeting”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Ever find the perfect thing to say an hour after the meeting ended?”

Body

“That isn’t a confidence problem. Under pressure, the brain shifts its priorities, and clear thinking gets harder for a moment. I have a PhD in neuroscience and I was a COO, and the leaders I work with learn a short reset that brings the clear thinking back in the moment, not an hour later.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass for women leaders. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera in a bright home office, cream blouse, soft natural light.

Script 2 · “The conversation you’re putting off”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“There’s a conversation on your list you’ve moved to next week three times.”

Body

“Feedback for someone on your team. Pushback for your boss. A boundary with a peer. Putting it off doesn’t make it easier, it just makes it heavier. There’s a simple structure for these conversations, and once you have it, you stop dreading them.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in the Steady Leader Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: walking to camera, on-screen text listing “feedback, pushback, boundaries” in dusty rose.

Script 3 · “What the COO in me learned”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“As a COO I learned the hard way: how you say it matters as much as what you say.”

Body

“The best strategy in the room goes nowhere if it lands badly. Senior leaders listen to people who stay steady, frame the decision clearly and don’t over-explain. That’s a skill, and you can learn it.”

CTA

“I’ll break it down live. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple slide with three points.
